correctness.rationale: For N=2^n and Boolean Walsh-Weyl basis W_{u,v}, Hilbert–Schmidt orthogonality and covariance of the full N² orbit give singular values sqrt(N)|A_z(u,v)| (for unnormalized g_z). Only shifts of weights 0,2,4 have nonzero ambiguity. Weight0: |z|²+K_{n,2}(w). Weight2: unequal Walsh signs give −2i Im z, equal signs give 2(Re z+epsilon(n−2−2j)). Weight4: K_{4,2}(r), magnitudes 6 for N/8, 2 for 3N/8, zero N/2 each. Counting zeros produces rank N−Z0+binom(n,2)(N−Z2)+binom(n,4)N/2, with defect loci explicit; z=n+i avoids them. Weight4 positive modes dominate all others by O(n^-2), proving uniform weak law 3/4 delta_2 +1/4 delta_6 for ANY z_n. Independent direct autocorrelation enumeration verified dimensions 4..6 multiple rational/complex z; all-order proof is algebraic.
